data.review_body:
Initially I had a good experience and that got better as they improved their site, such as checking addresses  before confirming an order. However, at one point the charge card I had on file with them was compromised and I cancelled it, forgetting  which businesses I had assigned it to. I didn't get and order, in retrospect I believe because of the credit card, but though it must have been out of stock. My next order I got informed about the credit card problem. I immediately contacted them and was told to put in a different credit card. I tried 3 and none worked. After various contacts with them I was informed that my account had 'discrepancies.' There was no indication of what these were nor any way to fix them. Having spent so much time trying to sort it out, I decided I would no longer do business with them. I particularly found the anonymous information about discrepancies offensive and unprofessional on their part. I have found other companies with much the same items I had gotten from them, sometimes better made. I cannot offer on explicit date as this communications happened over many weeks. My date of choice is approximate.
I was asked to provide further information and, as with my other interactions with TEMU, this is quite vague. I have explained that it happened over time with the final annoyance being that I could no longer have an account as none of my credit cards were accepted and, also, that I was charged with having, again anonymous, discrepancies in my account. In my case the customer, who, incidentally, has an excellent credit rating, does not come first, or anywhere else on the list. The customer is condemned by vague innuendoes. If you want more information, I suggest you check your own files.
data.review_headline: I was told my account had discrepancies, but given no particulars. I guess an excellent credit rating doesn't count for much, nor a history of being a good customer.

DO NOT SHOP FROM TEMU! THEY ARE THIEVES! THEY TAKE YOUR MONEY AND DO NOT DELIVER YOUR GOODS! THEY ARE IN CAHOOTS WITH EVRI!
ORDER NOT DELIVERED & REFUND REFUSED – UNACCEPTABLE CUSTOMER CARE
RATING: ⭐ (1 STAR)
I PLACED ORDER PO-210-09746860520310369 ON 14 JUNE 2026. ON 21 JULY, IT WAS MARKED AS "DELIVERED" BY EVRI, BUT I NEVER RECEIVED THE PARCEL.
I LIVE ALONE IN A 21-STOREY BUILDING WITH OVER 120 IDENTICAL FLAT DOORS. THE COURIER'S DELIVERY PHOTO MERELY SHOWS A PARCEL OUTSIDE AN UNIDENTIFIED DOOR WITH NO FLAT NUMBER OR FLOOR. THERE IS ZERO PROOF THIS WAS DELIVERED TO MY ACTUAL PROPERTY. AS WIDELY REPORTED IN UK NEWS, COURIERS FREQUENTLY TAKE A QUICK PHOTO OF A PARCEL OUTSIDE A RANDOM DOOR AND THEN TAKE THE ITEM BACK WITH THEM.
DESPITE PROVIDING PHOTOGRAPHIC EVIDENCE OF THE IDENTICAL DOORS IN MY BUILDING AND CITING MY RIGHTS UNDER THE UK CONSUMER RIGHTS ACT 2015 (SECTION 29), TEMU CUSTOMER SERVICE REFUSED MY REFUND (£17.87) AND SENT AUTOMATED RESPONSES. THEIR SYSTEM INITIALLY APPROVED THE REFUND, THEN CHANGED IT TO "REFUND FAILED" WITHOUT EXPLANATION.
REFUSING TO REFUND AN UNDELIVERED PACKAGE IS COMPLETELY UNACCEPTABLE. I HAVE NOW FORMALLY DISPUTED THE TRANSACTION (CHARGEBACK) THROUGH MY BANK. AVOID TEMU IF YOU EXPECT BASIC CUSTOMER PROTECTION.

data.review_body:
First off, let me start by saying that I’m making a review on the experience I’ve had with the app and the experience that I’ve had with shopping on temu.com
I’m rating the Temu app with a NEGATIVE 5 based on its EXTREME persistence to push you to buy with the spinning wheels and flash fast messages no matter how many times you try closing the “game” windows. Every time you hit to close out ANOTHER game window pops up insisting that you “spin the wheel”. The other thing that is concerning is the excessive texts you receive from them, especially the ones stating that because you’re such a great customer and they’re “feeling generous” they are “reimbursing your purchase”. To be clear, the definition of reimbursement means ‘to return monies [you’ve spent] on a purchase’. I fell for that trap thinking I was actually receiving money back from Temu because the price on an item I bought had dropped between the time I purchased the item/s and the time it shipped. No! I followed the prompts guiding me to “choose an item” to qualify for said reimbursement and hit checkout only to find that there is no reimbursement but that I was charged FULL PRICE for the items I was supposed to get said reimbursement on!!! I had to then go through the process of requesting a refund for what they charged to my account!! This happened day before yesterday.
I did some research on Temu and their horrible performance and will take the suggestion of someone else who was taken in by their ploys and delete my account and block them from texting me. IF I feel to buy more of what I previously bought I’ll only shop through my private browser, using an entirely separate account and private phone number.
Next, my purchases: I have bought women’s pjs, pants, sneakers and rechargeable lights, a tiny air cooler fan system with a water misting capability, a cat toy and some other small things that I’m truly happy with. But I *have* found MANY sellers that have padded their items with fake or several times reposted “customer” reviews to try fooling you into thinking the item is a 5 star perfect purchase. Often you’ll see the EXACT product pictured several times but under a different seller name for either more or very slightly less than the price you looked at. BEWARE!! I’ve reported those and blocked them but I don’t have confidence that Temu’s “security” actually follows through on those alerts.
So far, I’ve received my items in good shape, secured boxing and in ziplock bags for the clothing. But they need to do MUCH better overall.
data.review_headline: Negative 5 or an ‘F’ grade for their app
